name: openlab
description: openlab 科研 Agent 框架

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently --kill-others --names frontend,electron --prefix-colors green,yellow "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run electron:compile && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run pyinstaller && npm run frontend:build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --win
